{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Unique arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique severities:", df['severity'].unique())
print("Responded value counts:", df['responded'].value_counts())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())"}
